Buying in Kamala, Phuket?

Kamala is a west-coast area in Kathu district, between Surin and Patong. Kamala Beach, a hospital and several shops are listed in the project data; one project here is about 300 m from the beach according to its description.

Area guide with projects, nearby places and FAQs: https://estate.nightdestiny.com/locations/kamala/

Prices and availability can change; check the project page or ask us for the current details. Images may be developer renders.
